quarterly_data.quarter: ACM Research press release: ACM Research's Ultra ECP ap-p Horizontal Panel (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ultra ECP ap-p horizontal panel-level electroplating orders as stated in the release: the first production order for one 510 x 515 mm tool from an existing advanced packaging customer in mainland China, delivery scheduled for the first half of 2027, and an evaluation order for one 310 x 310 mm tool from a new leading panel-manufacturer customer based in Asia, delivery scheduled for the fourth quarter of 2026 (customers not named). ACM says it believes the tool is the world's first commercial horizontal panel-level copper deposition system for the large panel market (company claim); it supports plating steps across pillar, bump and redistribution layer (RDL) processes, panel formats of 310 x 310 mm, 510 x 515 mm and 600 x 600 mm, and copper, nickel, tin-silver and gold plating. CEO David Wang: 'We are encouraged by the customer response reflected in these orders' and remain committed to supporting customer qualification and volume-production adoption.
quarterly_data.figure: one 510 x 515 mm production tool (delivery first half of 2027); one 310 x 310 mm evaluation tool (delivery fourth quarter of 2026); Cu, Ni, SnAg and Au plating
